Currently working as a research assistant focusing on image generation technologies and related AI systems. Exploring novel generative architectures and optimizing inference pipelines for state-of-the-art models.

Project Work

MNIST Neural Network & Autograd Engine from Scratch

C++ Deep Learning
  • Implemented a complete deep learning framework from scratch in C++17 with zero external ML libraries, building a custom Tensor class, a dynamic computation graph, and a full autograd engine that mirrors the internal mechanics of PyTorch's gradient tape.
  • Designed gradient node classes (AddGrad, MatMulGrad, ReLUGrad, CrossEntropyGrad) and implemented reverse-mode automatic differentiation via topological-sort-based backpropagation.
  • Built core operations from first principles: matrix multiplication, ReLU activation, numerically stable softmax (max subtraction), cross-entropy loss, and an SGD optimizer with Xavier weight initialization.
  • Engineered a CSV-to-binary IDX format converter for Kaggle MNIST compatibility, plus a low-level big-endian IDX binary file reader for both image and label archives.
  • Trained a two-layer MLP (784 → 128 → 10) over 5 epochs with mini-batch SGD (batch size 64, learning rate 0.01), validating end-to-end correctness on the MNIST test set.
C++17Custom AutogradBackpropagationSGD

Mask Detection Using YOLOv8

Computer Vision & Deployment
  • Trained YOLOv8 (medium variant) on a custom mask-detection dataset using transfer learning from COCO pretrained weights, producing one of the earlier rigorous YOLO-based approaches to this task.
  • Configured a full training pipeline with dataset.yaml specification, 10-epoch training at 640×640 input resolution, and confidence-thresholded (0.5) inference with class-specific bounding box annotation.
  • Deployed the trained model as an interactive Streamlit web application supporting both live webcam feed with real-time FPS metering and video file upload.
  • Implemented frame-level preprocessing: horizontal mirroring for natural webcam orientation and coordinate rescaling to map inference-resolution detections back to original frame dimensions.
PythonYOLOv8PyTorchOpenCVStreamlit

IELTS Writing Score Prediction System

NLP + Full-Stack ML
  • Fine-tuned a BERT-based regression model to predict IELTS writing scores, comparing text-only and hybrid (text + structured features) architectures.
  • Conducted EDA to assess score distribution, class imbalance, and feature relationships (e.g., essay length vs. score).
  • Performed feature engineering and preprocessing: tokenization, essay length extraction, one-hot encoding, and feature scaling.
  • Improved model performance via architecture experimentation and training optimizations (early stopping, checkpointing), evaluated using MAE and RMSE.
  • Developed a Flask-based REST API for real-time inference, integrated with an HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend.
  • Deployed models in TensorFlow Saved Model format for scalable, production-ready integration.
TensorFlowHugging FaceFlaskScikit-learn

MOSS-TTS 1.7B Inference Pipeline

Google Colab
  • Built an end-to-end Gradio inference pipeline for the MOSS-TTS 1.7B zero-shot voice-cloning model, optimized for Google Colab's T4 GPU environment.
  • Integrated spaCy sentence segmentation for accurate multi-sentence synthesis; generated per-segment WAV files with serial numbering and batch ZIP packaging.
  • Implemented GPU memory management strategies including torch.inference_mode(), gradient-free execution, cuda.empty_cache(), and lazy model loading to fit within 16 GB VRAM.
  • Designed a configurable multi-preset quality system (8–32 RVQ layers) with adjustable sampling parameters (temperature, top-p/k, repetition penalty).
